preheader: Jio's record $100B IPO, Apple's folding phone cracks, and Gen Z trades the midterms.

lead.headline: Jio Platforms IPO draws a record 1 crore applications
lead.body: Jio Platforms became the first public offering globally to cross 1 crore applications, with overall bidding reaching nearly seven times the available shares. Backed by Reliance Industries, the digital services company is set to join an exclusive club of founder-led businesses valued above $100 billion at IPO, alongside Meta, Alibaba, and SpaceX.
lead.why: When studying market demand and valuation multiples at Merage, look at how emerging market digital infrastructure giants can generate massive institutional and retail demand.

stories.headline: Gen Z treats midterm elections as a trading catalyst
stories.body: A survey from the Nationwide Retirement Institute revealed that 72% of Gen Z investors adjusted their retirement or investment portfolios ahead of the November elections, compared to just 17% of baby boomers. Younger investors are actively repositioning assets around political cycles rather than staying passive.
stories.why: In your student investing pitches, test whether tactical reallocation around macro political events consistently outperforms regular dollar-cost averaging.

stories.headline: Wall Street runs tokenized loans on its $359 billion repo market
stories.body: Financial institutions are using blockchain networks to execute short-term borrowing in the $359 billion daily repo market. The setup lets institutions pledge government bonds to unlock intraday cash between breakfast and lunch while lowering transaction costs.
stories.why: Understanding how core banking plumbing like overnight repos is modernized gives you strong talking points for investment banking and fintech interviews.

stories.headline: Apple releases $2,000 foldable iPhone Duo as display issues surface
stories.body: Apple rolled out its first folding phone, the iPhone Duo, with a $1,999 price tag across global stores. Early buyers have already begun reporting cracked inner displays along the fold line, with one owner noting screen failure after fewer than 20 folds.
stories.why: For product management and case competitions, track how quickly hardware reliability problems can harm consumer sentiment on high-margin flagship devices.

stories.headline: Older Nvidia GPUs gain rental value as AI token use climbs
stories.body: Soaring AI token consumption is turning older graphics processors into appreciating assets in the cloud rental market. Six-year-old chips like Nvidia's A100 are commanding rental premiums of up to 143% as developers scramble for compute to run large language models.
stories.why: If you model operating costs for an AI venture, compute expenses do not always fall over time when aggregate model inference demand spikes.

stories.headline: MBA recruiters sweeten internship packages with housing and tuition
stories.body: Companies are turning internships into their primary pipeline for management hires, offering tuition assistance, subsidized housing, and executive access alongside standard pay. Career leaders report that employers increasingly want interns tackling live strategic challenges rather than standard busywork.
stories.why: As you prepare for internship recruiting at Merage, look for programs that offer project ownership and direct mentorship rather than just high base stipends.

stories.headline: McKinsey Asia head highlights strong performance of owner-led businesses
stories.body: McKinsey Asia chairman Gautam Kumra highlighted that owner-led companies produced $7 trillion of the $14 trillion in market value generated by Asia's top 300 firms over the past 25 years. He noted that sustaining this performance requires scaling beyond local borders and accelerating AI adoption.
stories.why: This is a clean corporate governance case study you can apply to strategic management classes when evaluating founder control versus hired management.

stories.headline: UC Irvine Langson OCMA opens exhibition for painter Tokio Ueyama
stories.body: UC Irvine's Langson Orange County Museum of Art is presenting 'Tokio Ueyama: The Hollows Between Mountains.' The exhibition displays landscape, still life, and portrait paintings that document the history and experiences of Japanese immigrants.

stories.headline: Leylah Fernandez beats Marie Bouzkova to reach Ningbo Open final
stories.body: Canada's Leylah Fernandez advanced to the final of the Ningbo Open after defeating Czech player Marie Bouzkova 6-3, 7-5 in the semifinals. The unseeded Canadian will face defending champion Elena Rybakina in the title match.

term.name: Repo market
term.definition: Short for repurchase agreement, the repo market is a vital financial hub where institutions borrow short-term cash by pledging safe securities, like government bonds, as collateral. The borrower agrees to buy the securities back shortly after, often overnight, at a slightly higher price that reflects interest. Wall Street relies on this multi-billion dollar daily market to keep funding flowing across the financial system.

serve.headline: Higgsfield expands Series B with backing from Nvidia and TCV
serve.body: Higgsfield develops generative AI software for video and image creation aimed at marketing agencies and entertainment firms. The San Francisco startup secured fresh capital by extending its Series B round with investments from Nvidia and growth equity firm TCV.
